submission.justification: Sensor-T1 at 150 μm thickness achieves the best single-hit spatial resolution of 5.914 μm among all tested configurations. This represents a 33.7% improvement over the best Sensor-T2 configuration (8.967 μm at 100 μm thickness) and a 57.3% improvement over the best Sensor-T3 configuration (13.862 μm at 150 μm thickness). The systematic simulation across all three sensor technologies at six thickness values (50, 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300 μm) confirmed that Sensor-T1 at 150 μm provides optimal performance for the innermost pixel layer. This configuration meets all project constraints: it is one of the three approved candidate technologies, suitable for the harsh radiation environment of the innermost layer, and falls within the specified thickness range of 50-300 μm.
